faq.a: Each Club session will have one or more key topics that the members are expected to discuss. The facilitator will kickstart the discussion, but from that onward is on you our fellow Product Managers.

faq.q: Do I need to save a seat?
faq.a:
Yes. We're committed to creating a safe and welcoming space for our attendees, which is why we limit the number of participants per session.
To avoid missing out, sign up for our mailing list and be the first to know when a new club session becomes available for registration.

Our aim is to create a dynamic and engaging experience for everyone, so while the event is designed to last around 90 minutes, we're flexible to adjust to the conversation flow and ensure everyone has a valuable experience.
